infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Homebase uses your location to set your household's home, and to check whether you're inside your home's area when the app opens. Only home or away is shared, never where you are.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Homebase checks whether you're inside your home's area when the app opens and when you cross its edge, even while the app is closed. Only home or away is shared, never where you are.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Homebase uses your location to set your household's home, and to check whether you're inside your home's area when the app opens. Only home or away is shared, never where you are.
